svg.title: K values at 70 °F (21.1 °C) and 1 atm
svg.text: High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 1 atm = 101.3 kPa (top of the pressure scale).
Mark T = 70 °F = 21.1 °C on the temperature scale.
Join the two marks with a straight edge.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
